A company runs multiple applications on Amazon EC2 instances and stores configuration files in an Amazon S3 bucket. A solutions architect must give the applications access to the configuration files while following AWS security best practices. Which solution meets these requirements?
Use access keys for the AWS account root user.
Use an AWS access key ID and EC2 secret access key.
Use IAM roles to grant the applications the necessary permissions.
Activate multi-factor authentication (MFA) and versioning on the S3 bucket.

An application is experiencing performance problems because of increased demand. The demand comes from read-only historical records retrieved from an Amazon RDS database using custom views and queries. A solutions architect must improve performance without changing the database structure. Which approach improves performance and minimizes administrative overhead?
Deploy Amazon DynamoDB, move all ... and point ... [The remaining source text is missing.]
Deploy Amazon ElastiCache (Redis OSS) and cache the application's data.
Deploy Memcached on Amazon EC2 and cache the application's data.
Deploy Amazon DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) on Amazon RDS to improve caching performance.

A company must give a small group of auditors read-only access to an Amazon S3 bucket containing sensitive audit logs. The auditors review the logs once a month. Each auditor has an IAM user. The bucket must remain private to the account. Credentials must be temporary and rotate automatically. Access must expire at the end of the monthly review period, and all activity must be traceable to individual users in AWS CloudTrail. Which solution meets these requirements?
Generate presigned URLs for the required objects that expire at the end of the review period. Send them to the auditors before each review date.
Create an IAM role with read-only access to the S3 bucket. Include a condition that allows auditors to assume the role during the monthly review period.
Add each auditor's IAM user to the bucket ACL with read permissions. Remove each auditor's IAM user from the bucket ACL after the review period.
Enable S3 static website hosting. Use a bucket policy to restrict access to each auditor's corporate IP address range, with a condition allowing access only during the review period.

A company processes streaming data from internet-connected devices using Amazon Kinesis Data Streams and AWS Lambda functions. The company is experiencing scaling problems and needs shard-level control and custom checkpointing. Which solution meets these requirements with the LOWEST latency?
Connect Kinesis Data Streams to Amazon Data Firehose to deliver incoming data to an Amazon S3 bucket. Configure S3 event notifications to invoke the Lambda functions.
Adjust the Lambda functions' provisioned concurrency settings. Stream data from Kinesis Data Streams to an Amazon SQS standard queue. Invoke Lambda functions to process the messages.
Run the Lambda function code in Amazon ECS containers on AWS Fargate. Modify the code to use the Kinesis Client Library (KCL).
Increase the Lambda functions' memory and provisioned concurrency settings. Stream data from Kinesis Data Streams to an Amazon SQS FIFO queue. Configure the SQS queue to invoke the Lambda functions.

The company wants an AWS service that monitors attacks against resources in near real time. The service must also provide a dedicated AWS team to help respond to DDoS attacks. Which AWS service meets these requirements?
AWS WAF
AWS Shield Standard

A media publishing company is developing an application on AWS that allows users to print their own books. The application's frontend runs in Docker containers. Incoming order volume varies significantly and sometimes temporarily exceeds the throughput of the company's book printers. Order processing payloads can be up to 4 MB. The company needs a solution that scales to process incoming orders. Which solution meets this requirement?
Use Amazon SQS to queue incoming orders. Create an AWS Lambda@Edge function to process orders. Deploy the frontend application on Amazon EKS.
Use Amazon SQS to queue incoming orders. Create an AWS Lambda function to process orders. Deploy the frontend application on AWS Fargate.
Use Amazon SQS to queue incoming orders. Create an AWS Lambda function to process orders. Deploy the frontend application on Amazon ECS using the AWS Fargate launch type.
Use Amazon SNS to queue incoming orders. Create an AWS Lambda@Edge function to process orders. Deploy the frontend application on Amazon EC2 instances.

A company needs to migrate its customer transaction database from on premises to AWS. The database runs on an Oracle DB instance on a Linux server. New security requirements mandate changing the database password annually. Which solution meets these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

Use AWS SCT to convert the database to Amazon DynamoDB. Store the password in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store. Create an Amazon CloudWatch alarm to invoke an AWS Lambda function for annual password rotation.
Migrate the database to Amazon RDS for Oracle. Store the password in AWS Secrets Manager. Enable automatic rotation on an annual schedule.
Migrate the database to an Amazon EC2 instance. Use AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store to retain the connection string and an AWS Lambda function to rotate it annually.
Use AWS SCT to migrate the database to Amazon Neptune. Create an Amazon CloudWatch alarm to invoke an AWS Lambda function for annual password rotation.

A company stores infrequently accessed data in the AWS Cloud. When the company needs the data, it must be retrieved within 12 hours. The company wants a cost-effective solution with a low storage cost per GB. Which Amazon S3 storage class meets these requirements?
S3 Standard
S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval
S3 One Zone-Infrequent Access (S3 One Zone-IA)
S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA)

A company has an ecommerce application accessed through multiple mobile and web applications. The company needs a solution that receives requests from these applications through an API. Request traffic varies significantly throughout the day and spikes during sales events. The solution must be loosely coupled and ensure that no requests are lost. Which solution meets these requirements?
Create an Application Load Balancer (ALB). Create an AWS Elastic Beanstalk endpoint to process requests. Add the Elastic Beanstalk endpoint to the ALB's target group.
Create an Amazon API Gateway REST API integrated with an Amazon SQS queue. Configure a dead-letter queue. Create an AWS Lambda function that polls the queue to process requests.
Create an Application Load Balancer (ALB). Create an AWS Lambda function to process requests. Add the Lambda function as an ALB target.
Create an Amazon API Gateway HTTP API integrated with an Amazon SNS topic. Create an AWS Lambda function to process requests. Subscribe the function to the SNS topic.

A financial company is migrating its banking applications to a group of AWS accounts managed by AWS Organizations. The applications store sensitive customer data on Amazon EBS volumes. The company takes regular snapshots for backup. The company wants controls across all AWS accounts that prevent public sharing of EBS snapshots. Which solution meets these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?
Enable AWS Config rules for each organizational unit (OU) in the organization to monitor EBS snapshot permissions.
Enable public access for EBS snapshots at the organization level.
Create an IAM policy in the organization's root account that prevents users from modifying snapshot permissions.
Use AWS CloudTrail to track snapshot permission changes.

A company runs Amazon EC2 instances as web servers. The web servers experience peak traffic twice a day and are idle for the rest of the day. A solutions architect needs to manage the web servers while maintaining fault tolerance. Which solution meets these requirements MOST cost-effectively?
Use an EC2 Auto Scaling group to scale instances based on demand.
Purchase Reserved Instances to provide peak capacity around the clock.
Use cron jobs to stop EC2 instances during periods of low traffic demand.
Use scripts to vertically scale EC2 instances during peak traffic demand.

A company deploys a three-tier web application on a single Amazon EC2 instance in one Availability Zone in us-east-1. Application usage is growing. A solutions architect must ensure that the application can handle increasing traffic and is resilient. Which solution meets these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

Create two additional EC2 instances in two different Availability Zones. Create an Application Load Balancer (ALB) and route traffic to a target group containing all three instances. Create Amazon CloudWatch alarms to vertically scale the EC2 instances to handle application traffic.

Create eight additional EC2 instances across three different Availability Zones. Create an Application Load Balancer (ALB) and route traffic to a target group containing all nine instances. Create an Amazon CloudWatch alarm to horizontally scale the EC2 instances to handle application traffic.

Create an EC2 Auto Scaling group with at least three EC2 instances in the same Availability Zone. Create an Application Load Balancer (ALB) and route traffic to a target group containing all instances. Configure scheduled scaling for the Auto Scaling group.

Create an EC2 Auto Scaling group with at least three EC2 instances distributed across Availability Zones. Create an Application Load Balancer (ALB). Configure the ALB to route traffic to a target ALB and then to a target group containing all instances. Create Amazon CloudWatch alarms to vertically scale the EC2 instances to handle application traffic.

A company is developing a data processing application using AWS Lambda functions. The functions must communicate with an Amazon RDS DB instance deployed in a VPC in the same AWS account. Which solution meets these requirements MOST securely?
Configure the DB instance to allow public access. Update its security group to allow access from the AWS Region's public Lambda address space.

Deploy the Lambda functions inside the VPC. Attach network ACLs to the Lambda subnets with outbound access allowed only to the VPC CIDR range. Update the DB instance's security group to allow traffic from 0.0.0.0/0.

Deploy the Lambda functions inside the VPC. Attach a security group to the functions with outbound access allowed only to the VPC CIDR range. Update the DB instance's security group to allow traffic from the Lambda security group.
Peer Lambda's default VPC with the VPC hosting the DB instance to allow direct network access without security groups.

A home security company is expanding globally. The company needs to encrypt customer data without managing the keys itself. The keys must be usable in multiple AWS Regions, and the company must control access to them. Which solution meets these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?
Use AWS KMS to create multi-Region keys. Apply tags to identify each key. Use attribute-based access control (ABAC) condition keys to control access to the keys.
Use AWS KMS to create multiple keys by importing key material. Apply tags to identify each key. Use attribute-based access control (ABAC) condition keys to control access to the keys.
Use AWS CloudHSM to create a CloudHSM cluster in the company's primary Region. Use CloudHSM Management Utility (CMU) to synchronize the cluster to other Regions.
Use AWS CloudHSM to create users. Use CloudHSM Management Utility (CMU) to share keys with users. Use the shareKey command to share or unshare keys with other users in each Region.

A company is developing a solution that provides customers with an API for financial data. The API backend must calculate tax data for each request. The company expects increased demand during the last three months of each year. A solutions architect must design a scalable solution that handles both normal demand and year-end peaks. Which solution meets these requirements?
Host the API on an Amazon EC2 instance running third-party software. Configure the instance to perform the tax calculations.
Deploy an Amazon API Gateway REST API. Create an AWS Lambda function to perform the tax calculations and integrate it with the REST API.
Create an Application Load Balancer (ALB) in front of two Amazon EC2 instances. Configure the instances to perform the tax calculations.
Deploy an Amazon API Gateway REST API. Configure an Amazon EC2 instance to perform the tax calculations and integrate it with the REST API.

A company hosts dozens of multitier applications on AWS. The presentation and logic tiers consist of Amazon EC2 Linux instances using Amazon EBS volumes. The company needs a solution that ensures new feature deployments do not introduce operating system vulnerabilities into the EC2 instances. The company deploys EC2 instances in Auto Scaling groups using custom AMIs. The solution must support all the company's hosted applications. Which solution meets these requirements?
Use Amazon Inspector to patch operating system vulnerabilities. Invoke Amazon Inspector when a new AMI is deployed.
Use AWS Backup to back up each updated instance's EBS volume. Create new AMIs from the EBS backups. Use the existing Auto Scaling groups to deploy the new AMIs.
Use AWS Systems Manager Patch Manager to patch operating system vulnerabilities in the custom AMIs.

Use EC2 Image Builder to create new AMIs when the company deploys new features. Include the update-linux component in the new AMIs' build components. Use the existing Auto Scaling groups to deploy the new AMIs.

A company needs secure remote access for administrators to manage Amazon EC2 instances in private subnets. All shell commands and session activity must be centrally logged for auditing. Administrators must authenticate with multi-factor authentication (MFA). The instances have no public IP addresses and must not allow inbound access from the internet. Which solution meets these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

Use AWS Systems Manager Session Manager with session logging enabled to Amazon CloudWatch Logs. Require IAM policies that enforce MFA. Ensure that the EC2 instances have AWS Systems Manager Agent (SSM Agent) installed.
Configure an EC2 Instance Connect Endpoint. Enforce IAM-based MFA. Use AWS CloudTrail to capture session activity.
Install and configure OpenSSH with local shell history logging on each EC2 instance. Use a NAT gateway for outbound access and enforce MFA at the SSH layer.
Deploy a bastion host in a public subnet and enable MFA for SSH access. Install the CloudWatch agent on the bastion host and configure it to stream SSH session logs.

A solutions architect has an application container, an AWS Lambda function, and an Amazon SQS queue. The Lambda function uses the SQS queue as an event source. When invoked, the function calls a third-party machine learning (ML) API that can take up to 60 seconds to respond. The function's timeout is currently 65 seconds. The solutions architect notices that the function sometimes processes duplicate messages from the SQS queue. What should the solutions architect do to prevent the function from processing duplicate messages?
Configure the Lambda function with more memory.
Increase the Lambda function's timeout value.
Configure the SQS queue's delivery delay to be longer than the maximum time needed to call the third-party API.
Configure the SQS queue's visibility timeout to be longer than the maximum time needed to call the third-party API.

A company is upgrading a critical web application hosted on Amazon EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB). The company wants to test the new configuration with a specific amount of traffic before routing all traffic to the upgraded application. How should a solutions architect design the architecture to meet these requirements?
Create a new launch template and associate it with the Auto Scaling group. Attach the Auto Scaling group to the ALB. Distribute traffic using redirect rules.

Create a new launch template and an additional Auto Scaling group. Associate the new launch template with the additional group. Attach the additional group to the ALB. Distribute traffic using weighted target groups.

Create a new launch template and an additional Auto Scaling group. Associate the new launch template with the additional group. Create an additional ALB and attach the additional group to it. Route traffic using an Amazon Route 53 failover routing policy.

Create a new launch template and an additional Auto Scaling group. Associate the new launch template with the additional group. Create an additional ALB and attach the additional group to it. Route traffic using an Amazon Route 53 weighted routing policy.

A company is building a data analytics platform using AWS Lake Formation. The platform will ingest data from sources such as Amazon S3 and Amazon RDS. The company needs a secure solution that prevents access to portions of the data containing sensitive information. Which solution meets these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?
Create an IAM role with permissions to access Lake Formation tables.
Create data filters to implement row-level security and cell-level security.
Create an AWS Lambda function to remove sensitive information before the data is imported into Lake Formation.
Create an AWS Lambda function to periodically query and remove sensitive information from Lake Formation tables.
